fields.statement: Built this branch's binary at 731d7f7 (go build ./cmd/rhiza) and drove it in a fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin, only rex/claude/gh faked, built-in build/review/ship-change unmodified, on a two-leaf change set (second depends-on first). rhiza run start ran build/build, build/check, render, review/code, review/review (5 of 5 checks), render-pr, open-pr, wait-pr, pr-green and stopped at signoff; a fresh clone of the pushed cs/ship-it passed rhiza check. rhiza run request-changes (one qa finding on leaf second) ran the fixer and verifier on second, re-ran only qa as cycle 2, then render-pr (visit 2) committed 'Render after the review', open-pr pushed and edited the PR; a fresh clone of the re-pushed head passed rhiza check, its rendered/actor pages including the cycle-2 fixer, verifier and qa sessions (the cycle-4 failure is gone). rhiza run approve ran rebase through land, merge, main-green, close-out and ship; the run succeeded, the change set landed, main passed rhiza check, worktree and origin branch gone, no shipit in any output.

Built this branch's binary at 731d7f7 (go build ./cmd/rhiza) and drove it in a fresh rhiza init repo with a bare origin, only rex/claude/gh faked, built-in build/review/ship-change unmodified, on a two-leaf change set (second depends-on first). The run stopped at signoff after green CI, run status naming https://github.test/o/r/pull/7; request-changes with one finding on leaf second started that leaf's fixer (its prompt held the finding) and verifier, re-ran only the qa check as cycle 2 under review/review, called open-pr again (1 pr create, 1 pr edit), waited for CI and stopped at signoff visit 2; rhiza run approve then moved on to rebase and land and the run succeeded; a second rhiza run approve exited 2.
